analyzed_vuln.description: Dereferencing a potentially null or invalid pointer in the GetData function, leading to a segmentation fault (SEGV) when attempting to read memory. The crash occurs because the function does not properly validate the indices it receives (nSet and nField) before accessing the data array.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: When the fuzzer calls cmsIT8GetDataRowCol with invalid row or column indices, it results in an out-of-bounds access in GetData, causing a segmentation fault. Specifically, if nSet or nField are greater than or equal to the number of patches or samples respectively, the function should return NULL but does not handle such cases properly.
